answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a beacon as the anchor of the cost.
